product_taxonomy: training-pipeline products_services codes A-L (not NACE; pipeline not distributed)

policy.unsupported: Retain semantic code; zero corresponding flags; report degraded coverage. Never substitute another industry.
policy.mixed_or_unknown_product: No product flags; missing products_services. L means none of the listed products, not unknown.
policy.agrifood: J (agricultural activity); P5 does not establish food manufacturing, so do not infer A.
policy.technical_services: D and G cover engineering and maintenance in the combined P5 option.
policy.health_life_sciences: I and F cover social/health services and scientific activities in the combined P5 option.
policy.size: YAML employee bands; 5000 belongs to LARGE (overlapping YAML endpoint resolved to first band). 1000_plus is a lower-bound estimate, not a known upper band.
